Content: The Ten Gods describe how every other part of a chart relates to your Day Master. They group into five themes: support, peers, expression, wealth and authority.
Source: Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia; Luck Pillars (dayun)

Content: Direct wealth is read as steady, planned earning. Indirect wealth is read as risk, sudden chances and ventures.
